title: AR52010: Architectural Conservation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definitions and concepts: Conservation, preservation, restoration,
reconstruction and adaptation. International framework of conservation: Venice
Charter, Burra Charter. Introduction to traditional building materials, causes
of decay and deterioration. Environmental influences: thermal effect,
corrosion and oxidation, irradiation. Methodology for investigation,
documentation and analysis of historic structures. Preparation of inspection
reports; Techniques for restoration, preservation and rehabilitation. Listing
and grading of heritage structures; Legal provisions for conservation of
heritage resources; Management and presentation of heritage buildings.
